name: Muldrotha, the Gravetide
oracle_text: During each of your turns, you may play a land and cast a permanent spell of each permanent type from your graveyard. (If a card has multiple permanent types, choose one as you play it.)
blocked_sentences: During each of your turns, you may play a land and cast a permanent spell of each permanent type from your graveyard

needs.what: a cast_from_graveyard permission (plus a land-play-from-graveyard permission) metered once per turn PER PERMANENT TYPE (artifact, creature, enchantment, land, planeswalker, battle) from the same granting permanent, where a card with several permanent types has its controller choose which type's use it spends as it is played
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cast_from_graveyard with affects_spells + static_max_per_turn is Edgar-shaped: casting._graveyard_cast_permission bills every use to one ledger slot per granting permanent (GRAVEYARD_CAST_SLOT keyed on source oid), so five per-type statics on Muldrotha share one counter -- cap 1 allows only one cast total, cap 5 allows five creatures. There is no per-type slot and no choice of which type an artifact creature spends. play_lands_from_graveyard is unmetered and not tied to that per-turn allowance either
